title: 第11章 师兄到底什么境界第12章 她难道是妖孽不成
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
【叮！
二阶妖兽‘碧鳞蛇’于领域内死亡，其部分妖力本源已被领域吸收转化，领域范围增加十五厘米！
【妖蛇兽核掉落，请宿主回收！
系统的提示音平静地在陆鸣脑海中响起。
陆鸣眨了眨眼，看着那妖蛇消失的地方，愣了一下。
这就没了？
我这领域……这么干脆的吗？
连灰都没剩下？
还真环保啊！
而且还能留下兽核。
这么说来，要是杀掉一些不长眼的邪修，是不是也能留下储物袋或者纳戒？
如此想着，陆鸣咂咂嘴，感觉这系统实在是杀人越货的不二选择。
而林清瑶此刻完全看呆了。
不是？？？
发生什么了？
怎么那妖蛇瞬间就湮灭了？
“师、师兄，那妖蛇……”
林清瑶疑惑扭头。
“死了。”
陆鸣语气平淡道：“我三番两次好意留它一命，可它执意找死，自然让它灰飞烟灭。”

陆鸣这么说完全是给自己找补一下。
林清瑶闻言，美眸瞪大，心脏狂跳！
没……没了？
灰飞烟灭？！
一条二阶妖蛇，就这么悄无声息地……没了？！
师兄这是何等通天彻地的手段？！
元婴修士能做到吗？
还是说，师兄的修为不止元婴境？
嘶~
所以……师兄到底是什么境界？
就在林清瑶思索之际。
陆鸣走到妖蛇消失的地方，从地上捡起一颗约莫鸽子蛋大小通体碧绿的圆润晶石。
正是那碧鳞蛇的兽核。
陆鸣掂量了一下，入手微凉，除此之外，什么都感觉不到。
这兽核对毫无修为的陆鸣而言，跟一块好看的石头没啥区别。
旋即，陆鸣随手就将这枚足以让许多筑基修士眼热的二阶兽核抛给了还在发愣的林清瑶。
“师妹，接住了。”
content_en:
【bite!
The second-level demonic beast 'Jade Scale Snake' died in the domain. Part of its demonic power has been absorbed and transformed by the domain, and the domain range has increased by fifteen centimeters!
[The demonic snake beast core has fallen, please host to recycle it!
The system's beep sounded calmly in Lu Ming's mind.
Lu Ming blinked and looked at the place where the demon snake disappeared, stunned for a moment.
Is this gone?
Is my field... so straightforward?
Not even ashes left?
It’s really environmentally friendly!
And it can also leave the beast core.
That being said, if you kill some evil cultivators who have no eyesight, can you also leave behind a storage bag or a ring?
Thinking of this, Lu Ming smacked his lips, feeling that this system was really the only choice for killing people and stealing goods.
Lin Qingyao was completely stunned at this moment.
no? ? ?
what happens?
Why was the demonic snake annihilated in an instant?
"S-Senior Brother, that demonic snake..."
Lin Qingyao turned her head in confusion.
"Dead."
Lu Ming said calmly: "I had good intentions to save its life time and time again, but it insisted on seeking death, so naturally it was destroyed."
Lu Ming said this just to make up for himself.
When Lin Qingyao heard this, her beautiful eyes widened and her heart beat wildly!
No...no more?
Completely wiped out? !
A second-level demonic snake just... disappeared without a trace? !
Senior brother, what kind of all-powerful method is this? !
Can the Yuanying monk do it?
Or is it that senior brother’s cultivation is beyond the Nascent Soul realm?
Hiss~
So...what is the realm of senior brother?
Just when Lin Qingyao was thinking.
Lu Ming walked to the place where the demon snake disappeared and picked up a round, green crystal about the size of a pigeon egg from the ground.
It is the core of the green-scaled snake.
Lu Ming weighed it and felt it was slightly cold, but other than that, he felt nothing.
To Lu Ming, who had no cultivation, this beast core was no different from a beautiful stone.
Immediately, Lu Ming casually threw the second-order beast core, which was enough to make many foundation-building monks jealous, to Lin Qingyao, who was still in a daze.
"Junior sister, caught it."
